text: My stepson, 12 months old. Temp 39.3. He's got little dark red/purple dots on his tummy and legs and they don't go when I press a glass on them, I've checked twice. The soft bit on top of his head looks raised and puffy, it's normally flat. Colour of his skin and lips looks normal. No fits, no shaking. Separate thing, he's not pooed in 3 days and has been grumpy about that. Do I take him in or not? Just need a straight answer please.
